format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-avatars id="lbl" template="label" label-text="Команда проекта" label-second-text="5 участников" avatar-size="2"></sf-avatars>

probes.title: the label combination prints both lines beside the avatar

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#lbl .sf-avatar-label-group'); return g && g.classList.contains('sf-avatar-label-group--size-2') && g.querySelector('.sf-avatar-label-group-title').textContent.trim() === 'Команда проекта' && g.textContent.includes('5 участников'); })()

probes.title: the group stacks the avatars and the remainder

steps.check: (() => { const avatars = document.querySelectorAll('#grp .sf-avatar-group-avatars > .sf-avatar'); return avatars.length === 3 && avatars[2].textContent.trim() === '+5' && avatars[0].textContent.trim() === 'АЗ'; })()

probes.title: the list written as a property redraws the group

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#grp'); el.removeAttribute('avatars'); el.avatars = [{text: 'ВП'}]; return true; })()

probes.title: the user combination prints the name and the source
the old data attribute still fills the fields, noted with its dates
nothing takes focus; the pictures are hidden from assistive technology
